text:
Maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding. We need to scope SSO requirements, KMS key policy, and entitlement/SKU mapping before legal asset handoff. Can everyone list blockers and owners?

Kai (Infra): I can take KMS + health endpoint. For AWS we need the CMK ARN and a specific key policy granting the marketplace account decrypt. I'll drop a template.

Maria (Partnerships): Awesome. Also need SSO mapping details: which OIDC claims/attributes the marketplaces expect. Sarah, can Legal confirm what metadata is mandatory for listing?

Sarah (Legal): Minimal required by legal/marketplace: trial duration, data processing contact, export-control statement, and a support contact email. Also marketplaces want an org identifier (DUNS or equivalent) on file. I'll upload redlines by EOD.

Jon (DevEx): One technical note — marketplace probes require a health endpoint. Standard is GET /healthz returning 200. We also need to accept an X-MP-Probe header with a shared token for the probe. Ops can route it to the service load balancer.

Kai (Infra): Sample KMS policy (replace AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ACCOUNT): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ACCOUNT:root"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Maria (Partnerships): :thumbsup: I'll create a Jira ticket with owners and a proposed EOD Friday deadline. Quick product question: do we offer a boxed trial SKU initially or meter-based usage? This affects billing metadata.

Sarah (Legal): Trial type matters. Meter-based requires usage dimension IDs and metering contract clauses; boxed trial needs SKU mapping and trial flags. Recommend boxed trial for first launch to simplify billing.

marketplace-bot: Checklist updated — https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checklists/1712001123. Items appended: kms-key, sso-claims, health-endpoint, legal-asset-upload, sku-mapping.

Maria (Partnerships): Great. Kai / Jon — can we do a 30m sync right after standup tomorrow to finalize endpoints and KMS ARN? I'll assign Jira and ping legal for DUNS info offline.
